title: Connection database-token lookup

scope.rationale: Attached-database lookup now has the source token-to-owned-name wrapper with guaranteed cleanup.

dependencies.caller_closure: The complete allocation, lookup, and cleanup wrapper is translated.

contracts.ownership: Temporary dequoted name is always freed after lookup.
contracts.state_and_results: OOM name conversion falls through to not-found while connection OOM state remains sticky.
contracts.locks_callbacks_io: No I/O; caller owns schema synchronization.
contracts.failure_and_continuation: Returns -1 for absent or allocation-failed name.

representation_differences: Typed nullable name is passed directly to findDatabaseName.

oracle.protocol: Look up quoted main, temp, attached, renamed-main alias, missing, and OOM token names.
oracle.normalization: Compare integer index and ownership state.

assurance.oom: Temporary name allocation failure returns -1 and preserves connection OOM state.
assurance.malformed_input: Token bytes are duplicated and dequoted by canonical helper.

known_blockers: Wire all token-based schema callers and focused OOM trace.

upstream_tests: Project schema and broad runtime tests
